from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
path=Path('/nfs/home/svu/ccepbs/nushpc/scratch.hw.hopper')
raw=path.read_bytes();lines=raw.decode().splitlines()
evidence=[{'line':i+1,'text':s} for i,s in enumerate(lines) if 'printf' in s and '$2/1024/1024/1024' in s and '$3/1024/1024/1024/1024' in s]
assert evidence
report={'quota_script':{'file':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},'unit_evidence':evidence,
 'usage_display_label':'GB','usage_actual_unit':'GiB = 1024**3 bytes',
 'quota_display_label':'TB','quota_actual_unit':'TiB = 1024**4 bytes',
 'du_reports_actual_unit':'decimal GB = 10**9 bytes',
 'numeric_forecast':'logs/review/diag_current_storage_forecast_01/report.json',
 'scope':'Read-only original CLI implementation; no quota scan or modification; allocated du and quota backend may also use different accounting bases; no exact summed peak is claimed.'}
out=Path('logs/review/diag_current_storage_units_01');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
body=(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n').encode();(out/'report.json').write_bytes(body)
(out/'unit_note.md').write_text('单位补充：原 hpc quota 的 scratch.hw.hopper 第46行将用量除以1024³、配额除以1024⁴，虽然标作GB/TB，实际是GiB/TiB。本次du表和新增242.533GB规划均为十进制GB；不得直接与CLI的879.8相加。du为当前allocated blocks，quota backend口径也未证明完全相同，因此不是精确峰值预测。原测量和forecast不修改。\n')
print('STORAGE_UNITS_JSON: '+json.dumps({'report':{'file':str(out/'report.json'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()},**report}))
